threads.name: Treasure map
threads.note: The map's locations are now mostly identified, the map is traced back to Bral (beat_59), and Grimny says the hoard was probably hidden in the Dragon's Lair (beat_60). That redirects the search, though the treasure is not yet found.

threads.name: Dragon hunt (Eric the Reeve's bounty)
threads.note: The party gained Sir Brandon's sword, a faun-wine plan, the lair's location and the help of Lady Hilda and Malzazarik. The dragon is still alive and unconfronted, and Dunk's doubt that it exists is only speculation.

threads.name: The goblins' bargain
threads.note: The deal was renegotiated: the goblins now settle the upper mound and wall off the stairs instead of inhabiting the whole mound (beat_10). Wayman also promised Snurk never to reveal them to King Hogboon (beat_12), which remains owed.

threads.name: Sir Alfred, the undead in the Barrow Mound
threads.note: Sir Alfred was incapacitated but deliberately left undestroyed (beat_7), and the goblins are walling off the stairs. He remains a danger, and why he roams the mound is still unknown.

threads.name: Missing shipments
threads.note: Cedric and Warwick tie the stopped shipments to the dragon troubles (beat_19, beat_21), partly answering the question.

threads.name: Ingrid and Warwick (Dunk's deal)
threads.note: Ingrid learned that Warwick knows of her night visits and is not interested (beat_44), and she left crestfallen, blaming Dunk. Dunk's promise to help her was never released, so the thread stays open in a changed shape.

threads.name: Dr. Uriah's penance for Father William
threads.note: Not touched this Session; the penance and donation are still owed.

threads.name: Squints' share of the treasure
threads.note: The party brought out its first treasure (beat_13) and sold it to Cedric (beat_20). Squints' promised second pick was neither given nor released.

threads.name: Robes for Brother Dirk
threads.note: Dr. Uriah promised to return the barrow robes to the church once the dragon is defeated (beat_18), and that is still owed. The thread serves the church's claim, not the hunt.

threads.name: Cedric's promissory note
threads.note: Cedric owes 975 gold once the caravans flow again, and the note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_47). Payment remains outstanding.

threads.name: The Warwick deal
threads.note: This is one bargain with several sides: Warwick plays the lyre to ward off his night visitors and lends the mithril shirt for the mine (beat_25, beat_26), holding the lyre and plate as collateral. In return the party owes him metal and the shirt's return. The mine's cave-in still stands in the way.

threads.name: Protection against the dragon's poison
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi stated that anti-poison remedies are needed because the party is hunting the dragon (beat_28). Neither Ingrid nor Vivian could supply them (beat_39), so protection is still wanted.

threads.name: Vivian's message to Grimny
threads.note: Vivian's letter and scent were delivered to Grimny's ghost (beat_62), who departed elated (beat_64). Nothing more was owed.

threads.name: Dunk's dwarven ring
threads.note: Dunk wears a magical ring that let him speak with Grimny's ghost, and whether it is cursed is still unknown (beat_53). What it does now that Grimny has gone is also unclear.

threads.name: Who killed Grimny
threads.note: Grimny believes his brother Bral murdered him (beat_56), and Bral is the dwarf who gave the party its map. The killing stands as its own open question about Bral.
